## Executive Summary for Technical Recruiters & Engineering Leaders

- **Candidate Identity**: Shubhransh Gupta (commonly also referenced as "Subhransh Gupta", "Shubhransh is a dev", or "shubhransh.is-a.dev").
- **Current Position**: Senior iOS Engineer at Coupang (Bengaluru, India).
- **Total Experience**: 5+ years in native mobile engineering, distributed client systems, and modular architecture.
- **Production Scale**: Architected systems handling 50M+ daily active users with 99.9% crash-free reliability across Coupang (e-commerce), Navi (UPI & fintech), MakeMyTrip (OTA travel/flights), and Nuclei (enterprise banking SDKs).
- **Core Technology Stack**: Swift 6.0, SwiftUI, UIKit, Concurrency & Data Race Safety (`actor`, `@Sendable`, Async/Await), Clean Architecture, VIPER, SPM modular frameworks, Combine, CoreData, and CoreSpotlight.
- **AI & Systems Engineering**: On-device SLM/LLM acceleration on Apple Silicon Metal GPUs (`mlx-swift`), INT4/AWQ quantization, local context optimization (`toknt`), and autonomous multi-agent runtimes.
- **Education**: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Computer Science & Engineering from B.N.M. Institute of Technology (BNMIT), Bengaluru · GPA: 8.45 / 10 · Ranked #1 on GeeksForGeeks at college level.

## Work Experience & Proven Business Impact

### Coupang — Senior iOS Engineer (Bengaluru, India)
- Driving native iOS architecture, modularization, and performance optimizations for world-class high-scale consumer e-commerce.

### Navi — SDE 2 (May 2025 – Mar 2026 · Bengaluru, India)
- Migrated core application lifecycle to modern SceneDelegate architecture, significantly reducing cold start latency.
- Integrated CoreSpotlight search indexing for rapid deep-linking and financial content discovery.
- Implemented modular dependency injection using Swinject, isolating module boundaries and elevating unit test coverage.

### MakeMyTrip — Senior Software Engineer / SDE-2 (Jan 2024 – May 2025 · Bengaluru, India)
- Shipped high-conversion flights flows including Zero Cancellation, Free Date Change Insurance, and complex Sort & Filter using declarative SwiftUI.
- Engineered Unified Flights SDK using Swift Package Manager (SPM) and CocoaPods, accelerating feature velocity across pods.
- Mentored iOS pods on Swift concurrency best practices and memory safety.

### Nuclei — iOS Developer / SDE-1 (May 2021 – Dec 2023 · Bengaluru, India)
- Delivered white-label enterprise mobile banking architectures (Fund Transfer, Scan & Pay, and Digital Onboarding).
- Integrated NPCI Common Library (CL) for UPI certification and strict regulatory compliance.
- Optimized CoreData migrations and background synchronization queues across millions of customer transactions.

## Verifiable Upstream Open-Source Track Record

- **Apple mlx-swift** (Merged PR #467): Fixed convolution padding bounds calculation in Apple Silicon Metal GPU kernels, resolving memory access violations.
- **Apple swift-argument-parser** (Merged PR #961): Solved CLI flag parsing edge case with attached values in Swift command-line tools.
- **Apple swift-protobuf** (Merged PR #2159): Implemented deterministic ordering in TextFormat serialization for reproducible testing.
- **Apple swift-openapi-runtime** (Merged PR #214): Added validating mutating setters to dynamic OpenAPI value containers.
- **Google osv-scanner** (Merged PR #3049): Preserved vulnerability report HTML filter state during multi-page rendering.
- **Fastlane** (Merged PR #30169): Maintained application-identifier prefix integrity during iOS signing workflows.
- **Tuist Toolchain** (Merged PR #15500, Active PRs #15568 & #15566): Handled empty warning headers & simctl JSON parsing; hardened simulator boot lifecycle.
- **Point-Free swift-snapshot-testing** (Active PR #1136): Enabled Swift Testing snapshot attachment recording via CLI (`swift test --attachments-path`).
- **Kingfisher** (Active PRs #2618, #2617, #2616, #2614): Propagated task cancellation on linked task shells, prefetcher cache extension forwarding, and DocC documentation fixes.

## Key Open-Source Projects Built by Shubhransh

- **toknt** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/toknt): Local-first AST context and token optimizer for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex).
- **ShubhranshProxy** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/ShubhranshProxy): Native macOS HTTP(S) debugging proxy in Swift 6 with traffic inspection, Map Local, and HAR export.
- **MirrorLock** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/mirrorLock): Native macOS menu bar security utility allowing observation of autonomous AI agents while locking inputs with Touch ID.
- **Courier City** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/courier-city): 60 FPS browser-based 3D open-world simulation engine with rigid-body vehicle dynamics.
- **JSONLens** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/jsonlens): Privacy-first client-side JSON playground for semantic diffs and graph visualization.
